## Outcome and scope

Describe the business problem and what this change adds or fixes.

## Contribution guide checklist

For catalog additions, follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), complete every item, or explain an exception below. For site-only changes, mark pack-specific items not applicable.

- [ ] GitHub Pages landing page explains the problem and vision, and shows the finished product with captioned screenshots of the running app (or real run output for script-only packs). Screenshots reviewed for real data and secrets.
- [ ] Synthetic-data example runs locally or in the reader's own Snowflake account, with self-contained setup and cleanup; `setup` matches.
- [ ] Apache 2.0 `LICENSE` is present, and a least-privilege option is offered (not only ACCOUNTADMIN).
- [ ] In-app callouts name the Snowflake capability behind each component and identify mocked behavior.
- [ ] README includes prerequisites and deploy steps for a customer's own account.
- [ ] README includes a Customize with Cortex Code section with example prompts.
- [ ] No customer names, logos, data, identifiers, identifiable business logic, or secrets (including history, screenshots, and URLs).
- [ ] Named owner and last-reviewed date are present.
- [ ] Validation notes include test dates and environments; limitations, costs, and cleanup are documented.
- [ ] One `packs.json` entry and the matching README catalog row are added/updated.
- [ ] Links were verified while signed out; restricted links are labeled and enforce access at the destination.
- [ ] `demoUrl` is empty if no hosted example exists; no temporary login URLs are included.
- [ ] Pack licensing and disclaimer are documented.

## Verification

- [ ] JSON is valid; JavaScript passes syntax checks.
- [ ] Search, Industry/Function filters, reset, and empty results work.
- [ ] Mobile (375px), light/dark mode, and keyboard navigation were checked.
- [ ] No third-party scripts, analytics, customer content, or official logo assets were added.
